profile.summary: The Alameda County Office of Education is a county education agency. It reviews school district budgets and Local Control and Accountability Plans, and acts as a liaison between the California Department of Education and the public school districts in Alameda County. It also provides training and support for educators and runs programs for vulnerable students.
